entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Central African Federation, a political institution in Zambia during Northern Rhodesia (Colonial Period) (1953–1963). Grew from Copper Belt Development and British South Africa Company. Led to the emergence of Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland and Independence Zambia 1964.
